hypothesis: Replacing deterministic lowest-index tie bias with checksum-balanced selection among equal minimum-priority eligible FXCM slots improves collision diversity without adding memory or transmitted state.
kill_condition: Retire on any identity or resource failure, or if exact 250k archive bytes are not strictly below the matched parent.
promotion_condition: At exact 250k, require roundtrip, deterministic second archive, decimal RSS compliance, and strictly fewer archive bytes than the unchanged parent; promote unchanged to exact 10M.
title: FXCM checksum-balanced minimum-priority replacement ties
